title: Priya evening platform jotter
notes:
Evening wrap-up for shift — quick brain dump before I forget. Mostly ops/triage + a couple things to hand off to morning crew.

18:40 — short summary:
- Cluster healthy overall but noticed slight bump in queue depth for model-serve-gpu pools (pool=rn-large, qdepth ~12 -> 18 around 18:10). Cold starts spiking for 6m window.
- Network flaps: one Azure region route (eu-west-3) showed transient packet loss ~0.5% 17:50-18:05, routing flapped to fallback region and recovered. No customer impact observed in logs.
- Spot reclaim: two nodes in dedicated-reserve-3 were reclaimed and replaced as expected. Replacements had slightly older AMI, need follow-up to ensure new kernel/driver combo (5.15+450) applied.

Rapid checklist (ran through, mark what I did):
- [x] Evicted hung init containers in rn-large-staging: kubectl delete pod rn-init-3b7 (was stuck in ImagePullBackOff)
- [x] Restarted envoy on zone-b-gw-02 (low mem pressure)
- [x] Scaled up pool rn-large by +2 replicas to soak load (autoscaler didn't react fast enough)
- [ ] Add missing AMI patching task to infra-ops board (left note)

Immediate TODO (for morning or next shift):
- Reconcile why autoscaler didn't kick for rn-large: check metrics (cpu/queue depth triggers), review HPA vs custom scaler. Jira INFRA-4823 assigned to me but need more detail.
- Validate AMI/kernel on replacements: run /opt/bin/check-driver across replaced nodes and gather driver/kernel versions. If mismatched, create rollout plan.
- Triage eu-west-3 transient: collate netflow + router logs, ping backbone provider (ticket id? forgot to open — open next).
- Confirm cache warmers ran for recently launched pods (we saw a few cold latency spikes). If not, add warm-up hook for the pool.

Notes to self:
- When scaling rn-large, use the scale-annotation hack to bypass cooldown (scale now -> annotate: infra.redwood/force-scale=true). This avoids waiting on HPA window for urgent bursts.
- Watch out: bumping replicas can increase KV cache churn; watch redis miss-rate for 10m after scale.

Small incidents + logs snippets:
- 17:56: /var/log/proxy: "route-change: fallback->eu-central-1 for job:abc123 cause:loss 0.52%"
- 18:03: /var/log/serve: "cold start ms median=230, p95=610 for rn-large"

Hand-off blurb for morning (put in shift notes channel):
"Morning team — left rn-large scaled +2, autoscaler needs deeper look (INFRA-4823). Replacements from dedicated-reserve-3 may have older AMI; please run check-driver and confirm kernel+cuda combo. eu-west-3 saw brief packet loss; no customer impact seen but collect netflow and consider opening provider ticket. I'll follow up on AMI patching doc tomorrow. — Priya"
